messages:
nina: Quick thought after the sync: what if instead of collapsing everything under one label we introduce a tiny 'mini-map' inside the breadcrumb row that shows the collapsed group hierarchy on hover. That could improve discoverability without widening the rail.

oz: Mini-map sounds neat. Can you sketch the behavior? Is it purely hover, or keyboard accessible too?

nina: Sketch: hover/click on the breadcrumb group chip opens a small floating panel showing group tabs + top 5 items with tiny icons. Keyboard: chip is focusable, Enter opens panel, arrow keys navigate, Esc closes. Panel should be dismissible and not steal focus permanently.

leo: Engineering notes: deep links must still open the right item and expand the collapsed nav. Plan: canonicalize to `/app/:org/workloads/:kind/:id`. Legacy `/app/:org/models/:id` -> server 301 and client router.replace to canonical. When route arrives we do: expand group, focus-without-scroll(targetRow), announce via aria-live "Models list opened".

kami: A11y: Make sure mini-map panel uses role="dialog" and traps focus while open. Also provide a clear label for screen readers and announce the current selection with aria-live when moving via arrow keys.

oz: UX question: should the mini-map allow direct copy-link on items? I want users to be able to right-click / copy link from the mini-map rows.

nina: Yes, each row should have a small kebab menu with "Copy link" and "Open in new tab". Links must be full canonical URLs (no legacy paths).

leo: Minimal client redirect middleware (psuedocode):
```
// on route change
if (path.match(/^\/app\/[^/]+\/models\//)) {
  const newPath = path.replace('/models/', '/workloads/models/')
  router.replace(newPath)
  telemetry.track('redirect.legacy_model')
}
```
Server should mirror with 301 to keep external shared links working.

kami: Accessibility checklist TODO: 1) mini-map dialog role+focus trap, 2) keyboard nav + arrow semantics, 3) aria-live announcements on expand/open, 4) focus-without-scroll implementation, 5) test VoiceOver + NVDA + TalkBack. I'll write up details.

oz: Nice. One more micro-copy nit: breadcrumb chip label could show short type + count like "Workloads (M:12, P:3)" when hovered. Keep visible label simple when collapsed.

nina: OK actions: @leo implement redirects + focus-without-scroll helper, @kami write a11y checklist, @oz iterate micro-copy and mini-map interactions in figma, I'll prototype the floating mini-map. nav-bot: add this to Thursday design review.
